findings.current: Aside from Cheongpung, this might be the first formidable opponent he’d encountered.

findings.current: He makes quite an impression. I doubt this is his first interview.
findings.defect: “Makes quite an impression” shifts the first reaction from Sama Pyo being intense to being memorable, and the second sentence weakens the source’s specific “not someone who’s only done one or two interviews” observation.
findings.rationale: “아주 강렬한데요” describes him as intense, while “면접 한두 번 본 놈이 아닌 것 같습니다” suggests he has substantial interview experience.
findings.replacement: He’s intense. He doesn’t seem like someone who’s only been through one or two interviews.

summary: Mostly faithful, with a few small shifts in who or what the narration describes.
